  CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  DECEMBER 23, 2024

  A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Negrete at 8:31 a.m., on
  Tuesday, December 23, 2024, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

  Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Lana Negrete
  Mayor Pro Tem Caroline Torosis
  Councilmember Jesse Zwick (Arrived at 8:36 a.m.)
  Councilmember Dan Hall
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Barry Snell
  Councilmember Natalya Zernitskaya (Arrived at 8:40 a.m.)

  Also Present:  City Manager David White
  City Attorney Douglas Sloan
  City Clerk Nikima S. Newsome

  CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 8:31 a.m., with all
  members present except Councilmembers Zernitskaya and Zwick. Mayor
  Pro Tem Torosis led the assemblage in the Pledge of Allegiance.

  PUBLIC INPUT FOR  No members of the public commented on Closed Session items.
  CLOSED SESSION,
  CALENDAR ONLY:

  CLOSED SESSIONS  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 8:34 a.m. to consider
  Closed Session items.
  (Councilmember Zwick
  arrived at 8:36 a.m.)  4.A. Closed Session: Public Employee Appointment - Gov. Code §
  54957(b): Consider public employee appointment; title: City
  (Councilmember Zernitskaya  Manager/Interim City Manager; Gov. Code § 54957.6: Conference with
  arrived at 8:40 a.m.)  labor negotiator; City negotiator: Mayor/Personnel Director;
  unrepresented employee: City Manager/Interim City Manager.

  The City Attorney advised this matter was heard with no reportable action
  taken.

  ADJOURNMENT  On order of the Mayor, the City Council meeting adjourned at 11:15 a.m.

  1  December 23, 2024
